entities.name: Identification procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure to request identification parameters from the UE. The network sends an IDENTITY REQUEST message and starts timer T3470.

entities.name: IDENTITY REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the network to the UE to request identification parameters. Contains the Identity type information element.

entities.name: IDENTITY RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to the network in response to an IDENTITY REQUEST message.

entities.name: Identity type information element
entities.description: Information element that specifies the requested identification parameters in the IDENTITY REQUEST message.

entities.name: T3470
entities.description: Timer started by the network when sending the IDENTITY REQUEST message. Stopped upon receipt of IDENTITY RESPONSE.

relations.description: The identification procedure includes sending the IDENTITY REQUEST message.
The IDENTITY REQUEST message contains the Identity type information element.
Sending the IDENTITY REQUEST message starts timer T3470.
Receipt of the IDENTITY RESPONSE message stops timer T3470.
